COMMAND_ID_CONFLICT.zh: 该请求已用于其他消息
COMMAND_ID_CONFLICT.en: This request was already used for another message

CONFIGURATION_CHANGING.zh: {action, select, steer {模型正在切换，请稍后补充} other {模型正在切换，请稍后发送}}
CONFIGURATION_CHANGING.en: {action, select, steer {The model is switching; add your follow-up after it finishes} other {The model is switching; send after it finishes}}

RUN_NOT_QUEUED.zh: 这条消息已离开队列，请刷新后重试
RUN_NOT_QUEUED.en: This message has left the queue; refresh and try again

STEER_TARGET_CHANGED.zh: 当前任务已改变，补充消息尚未发送
STEER_TARGET_CHANGED.en: The current task changed; the follow-up message was not sent

TASK_WORKSPACE_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 工作目录不可用，请恢复原位置后重试
TASK_WORKSPACE_UNAVAILABLE.en: The task directory is unavailable; restore its original location and retry

INVALID_TASK_WORKSPACE_ROOT.zh: 无法使用此位置，请选择可写入的目录
INVALID_TASK_WORKSPACE_ROOT.en: Choose a writable directory for task files

TASK_WORKSPACE_CONFLICT.zh: 工作目录与创建记录不一致，请检查原目录后重试
TASK_WORKSPACE_CONFLICT.en: The task directory does not match its creation record; check the original directory before retrying

PROJECT_PROMOTION_CONFLICT.zh: 该任务已用其他名称保存为项目
PROJECT_PROMOTION_CONFLICT.en: This task was already saved as a project under another name

INVALID_PROJECT_PROMOTION.zh: 只有未关联项目的任务可以保存为项目
INVALID_PROJECT_PROMOTION.en: Only an unassociated task can be saved as a project

TASK_WORKSPACE_SAVE_REQUIRED.zh: 请先将任务保存为项目
TASK_WORKSPACE_SAVE_REQUIRED.en: Save this task as a project first

FEATURE_REQUIRED.en: Update the client and try again

INVALID_QUERY_SCOPE.zh: 查询范围无效，请重新选择项目
INVALID_QUERY_SCOPE.en: The query scope is invalid; select the project again

NATIVE_QUERY_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 模型查询目录不可用，请检查服务器缓存位置
NATIVE_QUERY_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE.en: The model query directory is unavailable; check the server cache location

SESSION_DELETE_BLOCKED.zh: {reason, select, share {分享操作进行中，完成后再删除} other {先停止或处理未完成的任务，再删除会话}}
SESSION_DELETE_BLOCKED.en: {reason, select, share {A share operation is in progress; delete after it finishes} other {Stop or finish this conversation’s tasks before deleting it}}

SESSION_DELETE_SCOPE_CHANGED.zh: 会话已变化，请重新确认

SESSION_IN_TERMINAL.zh: 这个会话正在终端中进行
SESSION_IN_TERMINAL.en: This conversation is open in a terminal

NATIVE_SESSION_HELD_EXTERNALLY.zh: 这个会话正在 Riffet 之外的终端里运行，先在那里退出
NATIVE_SESSION_HELD_EXTERNALLY.en: This conversation is running in a terminal outside Riffet; exit it there first

TERMINAL_STILL_RUNNING.zh: 终端中的进程仍在运行
TERMINAL_STILL_RUNNING.en: The process in the terminal is still running

SESSION_BUSY.zh: 等当前回合结束后再试
SESSION_BUSY.en: Wait for the current turn to finish

TERMINAL_RESUME_UNSUPPORTED.zh: 这个 Agent 不支持在终端恢复
TERMINAL_RESUME_UNSUPPORTED.en: This agent cannot be resumed in a terminal

NATIVE_SESSION_NOT_STARTED.zh: 会话还没有开始，先发一条消息
NATIVE_SESSION_NOT_STARTED.en: This conversation has not started yet; send a message first

EXTERNAL_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.en: This conversation is no longer stored on this machine

EXTERNAL_SESSION_DIRECTORY_MISSING.zh: 会话所在的目录已不存在
EXTERNAL_SESSION_DIRECTORY_MISSING.en: The directory this conversation ran in no longer exists
